info.name: Google Workspace Suite (Docs, Sheets, Slides, Gmail)

description.content: Best-effort OpenAPI 3.1 covering the most commonly used REST endpoints across the Google Docs API (docs.googleapis.com), Google Sheets API (sheets.googleapis.com), Google Slides API (slides.googleapis.com), and the Gmail API (gmail.googleapis.com). All services use Google OAuth 2.0 user or service-account credentials.
